data.title: Red Line railway services suspended
data.description: Services on the suburban Red Line commuter railway were temporarily suspended on Saturday evening after an electrical system failure affected its signalling system.

data.title: Social Security Board election postponement urged
data.description: The People’s Party and a veteran labour leader have called for the Social Security Board election scheduled for Sunday to be postponed because of severe flooding in several parts of the country.

data.title: ONE Championship: Panpayak calls for Lamnamoonlek rematch over disputed punch
data.description: Panpayak Jitmuangnon has called for an immediate rematch with Lamnamoonlek Torfunfarm after alleging that a disputed punch following a referee’s intervention affected the outcome of their ONE Championship kickboxing bout.

data.title: Pope preaches ‘dignity and peace’ in Paris
data.description: PARIS - Pope Leo XIV said on Saturday it was possible to “live together in dignity and peace” as he met migrants in Paris, ahead of a giant open-air mass expected to gather hundreds of thousands of people on the iconic Champs Elysees.

data.title: AWC seeds new AWR REIT with five assets worth 48.4bn baht
data.description: AWC plans to transfer five premium properties worth at least 48.449 billion baht into its new multi-sector AWR REIT, with another nine projects under study.

data.title: Agencies team up to provide flood travel updates
data.description: With floods causing transport chaos across Bangkok, authorities are stepping up measures to assist travellers and tourists facing delays in getting to airports and, in some cases, missed flights.

data.title: Free parking at train stations, malls in flooded Bangkok
data.description: Many buildings around Bangkok and surrounding areas are offering free parking for people affected by flooding, including park-and-ride facilities at train stations and garages at shopping malls.

data.title: Northern property market slows new launches as Chiang Mai faces four-year stock overhang
data.description: Northern Thailand’s housing market is recovering gradually, but weak purchasing power and tight lending are slowing new launches, while Chiang Mai may need more than four years to clear existing stock.

data.title: Man City to appeal serious Premier League charges
data.description: MANCHESTER - Manchester City have been found guilty of all but one of 115 Premier League charges for breaching financial regulations, according to reports on Friday, in a ruling that will send shockwaves through English football.

data.title: Nepal tunnel survivor wants to help post-flood rebuild
data.description: KIRTIPUR , Nepal - Pulled alive 10 days after catastrophic floods trapped him in a tunnel, Nepali hydropower worker Kabir Maharjan is determined to help rebuild his country despite his own harrowing ordeal.

data.title: Indonesia fires threaten critically endangered orangutans
data.description: JAKARTA - Wildfires that tore through Indonesian Borneo's vast tropical forests have piled pressure on critically endangered Bornean orangutans, the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) said on Saturday.

data.title: All 50 Bangkok districts declared disaster areas
data.description: All 50 districts of Bangkok have been declared disaster zones as heavy rain continues to cause flooding, traffic problems and disruptions to daily life.

data.title: Iran proposes Hormuz plan, Trump reportedly refuses
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - Iran offered a plan to reopen the strategic Strait of Hormuz, Tehran said Friday, but within hours reports indicated that US President Donald Trump rejected the proposal.

data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on.

data.title: Time's running out
data.description: Siam Paragon Bangkok Watch Week 2026 is now running, bringing together more than 45 leading global watch brands, influential figures from the industry, collectors and enthusiasts from around the world to celebrate the art and culture of watchmaking.

data.title: Reclaiming private space
data.description: In A Room Of One's Own (1929), Virginia Woolf argued that women must have money and space to write fiction. A century later, a group of theatre artists expand the thesis of their predecessor's feminist polemic. Despite enjoying access to the material basis for creative pursuit, women nowadays are still excluded from their most private space -- their bodies -- and subject to patriarchal domination.

data.title: Memories in motion
data.description: When a story is told through different languages and cultures or shared with people from diverse backgrounds, it will be interpreted in ways that give the story new meanings.

data.title: Democrats face identity test
data.description: The Democrat Party's decision to take a harder line on the Senate election-fraud case is exposing a potentially costly fault line between its stated commitment to democratic institutions and the political identity of part of its traditional support base.

data.title: Hudson hails his 'best ever' War Elephants
data.description: Thailand begin their quest for Fifa Asean Cup glory in Bandung today, with head coach Anthony Hudson declaring he has never enjoyed working with a squad more as his side prepared to open their campaign against Pakistan.

data.title: EPL delivers another dose of drama and keeps the fans guessing
data.description: Due to the extended international break, there are no Premier League games for a couple of weeks. However, EPL fans can savour last weekend's action, in which the league gave us a reminder of its capacity to provide upsets and entertainment.

data.title: Port say bye to Sarawut, get Bandovic
data.description: Port FC have ended their relationship with head coach Sarawut Treephan by mutual consent, the Thai League 1 club announced yesterday, bringing to a close a decade-long association that yielded some of the most significant silverware in the club's recent history.

data.title: Snooker prospects 'at risk'
data.description: Thailand celebrates its snooker champions, but players and lawmakers say gambling regulations are making it harder to train the next generation.

data.title: Bew blazes into history
data.description: Thai sprint sensation Puripol Boonson announced himself among Asia's elite yesterday, shattering the Asian Games 100m record in astonishing fashion to storm into the final, due to be held later last night.

data.title: Thais target semis, China stand in way
data.description: Thailand's men's Asian Games football team will look to book a place in the last four this afternoon when they take on group winners China in a mouth-watering quarter-final at the Toyota Stadium in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan.
